about_the_game:
Musical Weapons

In Survivors SymphonYs, the tree at the center has to be protected. Its roots weave patterns of SymphonY, from the depth of the earth through time and space – the source of your magic. Therefore, your weapons are musical instruments, your attack patterns based on music. Each combination of instruments creates a musical variation, leading to over 28 million possible scores. The better your instruments harmonize, the more SymphonY you accumulate, the higher the tempo of the music, and the more damage you deal. Dash to the rhythm of the music for additional strength, to break bones, activate special attacks, and reflect bullets.

Explore and Defend

Your goal (in the full version) is to survive 4 days and to protect the tree at the center of your base. Will you be able to descent into the well of darkness and face the evil at the bottom of the abyss? Explore 5 hand-crafted levels - filled with more than 150 unique monsters - while listening for new musicians to help your cause. But beware: While carving your path through hordes of enemies, your base will also be attacked by the evil lurking in the well. You‘ll have to level up your defenses, sacrifice health, or warp back and forth to defend the tree. This calls for hard decisions to be made: Do you level up your weapons OR the defenders in your base? Do you keep exploring and gain more experience OR warp back to defend? Do you sacrifice HP to clear the base OR will this lead to an even quicker death?

                                            

                            Warp back and clear the base (not available in the demo).

Build your Base

Play all found musicians and assign them to buildings - to defend, raise stats and unlock new abilities! In between runs you level up your stats, abilities, and buildings.

            Assign musicians to buildings. Each musician effects a building differently.

Other Features:

  • Unlock 33 musicians and their weapons, 11 buildings, and 22 talismans.

  • This game is supposed to be challenging, but the difficulty is adjustable.

  • Play with Controller.

Demo Features:

  • The demo allows you to play the first of the five days. Try to survive and beat the boss appearing at dusk.

  • Includes 11 of the 33 instruments / characters. 

  • You won't be able to defend your base by sacrificing health, warp back, reflect bullets, or dash through bones yet. Those abilities are unlocked at a later days.

  • Continue the full version with your acquired progress.

  • Visit our Discord to give feedback or become a beta tester!

short_description: Survivors SymphonYs is a hybrid-auto-battler with musical weapons, dash abilities, rogue-lite and tower-defense elements. Explore 5 distinct Areas - listening for new characters - while defending your base from afar: level defenders, sacrifice HP, or warp back to protect your base!
